messages:
maria_cs: Kicking off onboarding for Alder Systems. Objectives: staging integration, security review, and pilot load test within 14 days. Who are our stakeholders and top risks?

lia_csm: Stakeholders: Claire (Alder PM, business lead), Arjun (eng lead), Priya (security), Mateo (data). They want twice-weekly demos and a dedicated onboarding cadence.

devon_pm: Timeline ask from Alder: pilot decision in 2 weeks. Proposal: daily standups days 1-4, then Tue/Thu syncs.

maria_cs: Success criteria: 1) API calls in staging pass auth and basic latency targets, 2) security checklist cleared, 3) internal team can run integrations and prompts without assistance.

ben_eng: Note on latency: p50 ~200ms likely on small models; p95 will vary. If they need long context or higher throughput, Dedicated capacity is required. I will send a perf matrix by EOD.

lia_csm: Renewal risks: single POC, bespoke payloads, EU-only processing requirement. Recommend we loop sales and legal early.

maria_cs: @tom_se can you outline EU residency options? Private vs hosted routing?

tom_se: EU-only doable via Private deployment or routing to EU-hosted models. Pilot will need a processing addendum; I can draft options and an SOW.

onboard-bot: ACTION CREATED: #1298 - "Alder EU data options" assigned to tom_se, due 2024-11-05.

devon_pm: Enablement plan: day 2 API + auth walkthrough, day 6 ops/cost controls, day 12 runbook workshop. Also provide an integration checklist.

maria_cs: For feedback capture: create a shared Google form + #alder-feedback channel. Daily quick pulse for first 5 days.

lia_csm: I'll own the pulse and weekly digest, will post the form link after standup.

ben_eng: Integration example to share with their engineers: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-mini","input":"hello"}'

maria_cs: Actions: ben_eng -> perf matrix; tom_se -> draft SOW; lia_csm -> feedback form + channel; devon_pm -> schedule trainings and publish runbook.

lia_csm: Additional risk: billing cadence vs reserved capacity leads may delay Dedicated. Loop sales now.

maria_cs: Agreed. @devon_pm please add sales@ to next update.

devon_pm: Will add sales and schedule next sync Monday 09:30 PT; first standup tomorrow 10:00 PT.

maria_cs: I'll post agenda and shared doc. :thumbsup:
